metadata.title: GAP-M: Governance-Aligned Post-deployment Monitoring
metadata.remarks: Mapping coverage does not demonstrate compliance or effectiveness. GAP-M controls are original to this work. Each 'supports' prop names a source element (NIST AI RMF 1.0, NIST AI 800-4, 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11)(iv)(B), CISA CPG 2.0); prop class gives the NIST IR 8477 relationship property; remarks give the rationale. Not a NIST, ONC, or CISA product.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The plan's review cycle and named roles feed the organization's periodic review of its risk management process. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: MANAGE 4.1 is the outcome that post-deployment monitoring plans are implemented; a plan covering the system is a component of that outcome. Pre-review audit: supported.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The plan's RACI is one place monitoring roles and lines of communication are documented. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Tiering monitoring intensity by risk sets the level of risk management activity from risk tolerance. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A documented plan makes the monitoring process and its outcomes transparent and controlled. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Listing validity, fairness, security, and privacy measures in each monitoring plan is one practice through which trustworthy characteristics enter monitoring procedures. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The plan documents the measurement approaches chosen for the specific deployment context. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Where the deploying organization runs validity monitoring, its plan is the process the attribute can describe. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Where the deploying organization runs fairness monitoring, its plan is the process the attribute can describe. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A per-system plan tailors measures to the use case instead of assuming a generic method. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Each deployed predictive AI system has an approved post-deployment monitoring plan that names an accountable owner and sets the measures, cadence, thresholds, escalation path, and remediation authority, with monitoring intensity tiered by risk.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Approve the plan before go-live; review it at least annually and after every material model update, threshold breach, or incident.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Approved monitoring plan with version history; responsibility (RACI) matrix; review minutes.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Before go-live; annually; on material change.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: System owner, approved by the AI governance body or equivalent

props.name: supports
props.remarks: GOVERN 1.6 asks for mechanisms to inventory AI systems; recording deployed AI systems in an inventory is what such a mechanism does. Pre-review audit: supported.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The inventory records the defined task and method of each deployed system, keeping that definition visible after deployment. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Recording each deployed AI intervention in the asset inventory is one way to bring AI components into the asset-inventory goal. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The inventory record keeps the developer's name and contact information current. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The inventory record states the output type (prediction, classification, recommendation, and so on). Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Version tracking keeps the record current as models and vendors change across the AI stack. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An inventory lists every deployed predictive AI system with its version, developer, task and output type, deployment sites, data inputs, monitoring plan, and a link to or copy of the current source-attribute record.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Update the inventory at deployment, update, and retirement; reconcile it against EHR configuration at least quarterly.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Inventory export with change log; quarterly reconciliation record.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: On change; quarterly reconciliation.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: AI governance office

props.name: supports

props.name: supports

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Contractual notice of developer incidents is an input to contingency processes for third-party AI failures. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Contractual notice of developer changes is one input to regular monitoring of third-party AI risk. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports

props.name: supports
props.remarks: New external validation settings are delivered under the contract's clause requiring notice of new validation results. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The party conducting new external testing is reported under the contract's clause requiring notice of new validation results. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Demographic representativeness of new external data is reported under the contract's clause requiring notice of new validation results. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Descriptions of new external validation processes are delivered under the contract's clause requiring notice of new validation results. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: New external validity results are delivered under the contract's clause requiring notice of new validation results. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: New external fairness results are delivered under the contract's clause requiring notice of new validation results. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Developer notices of model updates show how often the intervention is actually updated. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Contractual notice builds a working information-sharing channel between developer and deployer. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Contracts with the intervention developer require notice, within contract-defined time frames, of model updates, changes to known risks, new validation results, security incidents, and vulnerabilities, and delivery of updated source attributes.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Include notice clauses and time frames in contracts; track developer notices and confirm source attributes are refreshed after each notice.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Contract clauses; developer notice log; source-attribute refresh records.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: At contracting and renewal; on each developer notice.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Procurement with the system owner

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Adding AI compromise scenarios to the IR plan is one way to cover organizationally specific threats. Pre-review audit: unresolved.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The AI annex adds AI-specific stakeholders to the incident communications plan. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The AI annex makes explicit that confirmed cybersecurity incidents involving the AI system (for example, compromise of the model or its data) are reported under the general policy. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Updating the AI annex after each AI incident is one way to refine the incident response plan from lessons learned. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: An AI annex to the IR plan is one documented process for responding to and recovering from AI incidents. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Responding to a newly found AI risk follows the plan's AI procedures. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Incident response and recovery are named parts of a post-deployment monitoring plan. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A planned AI incident pathway lets teams identify and handle incidents. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: AI 800-4 (section 3.1.1) reports missing guidance on what to do when an anomaly is detected; the annex supplies that pathway. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incident response plans cover AI-specific incidents (performance collapse, harmful or biased outputs, misuse, compromise of model or data), with severity criteria, containment steps, internal and external communication, and reporting, and are exercised at least annually.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Add AI scenarios to the incident response plan and run at least one AI scenario in the annual exercise.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Incident response plan with AI annex; exercise after-action report.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Annual exercise; plan update after each AI incident.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Incident response lead with the system owner

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A findings-sharing policy is one way to communicate risks and impacts more broadly. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: An external sharing policy is one practice that enables information sharing about AI incidents and testing. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Sharing findings is one way incidents and errors reach relevant AI actors. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Deployers sharing findings is one contribution to a more mature information-sharing ecosystem. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A standing policy gives ecosystem-wide transparency a set place in operations. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Shared incident reports let large-scale patterns appear that a single deployer's log would miss. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Shared findings return newly found risks and limitations to the developer for the source-attribute record. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Sharing local outcome evaluations adds to the evidence base the attribute references. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Monitoring findings (incidents, drift, bias, security issues, outcome evaluations) are shared with the developer and, under a defined policy and subject to legal and privacy review, with peer deployers and sector bodies such as information sharing and analysis centers or patient safety organizations.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Apply a sharing policy that sets what is shared, with whom, how fast, and with what de-identification.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Sharing policy; log of findings shared and recipients.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: On each qualifying finding; policy reviewed annually.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: AI governance office

props.name: supports
props.remarks: System-specific training for monitoring staff and users is one form of AI risk management training that enables them to perform their duties. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: System-specific training is one process for establishing operator and practitioner proficiency. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A monitoring budget is one way resources required to manage AI risk are taken into account. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A monitoring budget makes financial, compute, and human resource costs explicit. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Training and staffing plans address the shortage of qualified monitoring staff. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Planned staffing keeps human review capacity in step with rollouts. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Budgeting for tooling and automation lowers the administrative burden of monitoring. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Monitoring has budgeted resources (outcome labels, compute, reviewer and clinician time, tooling), trained staff, and users trained on the intervention's intended use and limits.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Set the monitoring budget in the plan; train monitoring staff and users before access and when the intervention changes.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Budget line; training records; staffing assignments.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Annual budget; training at onboarding and on change.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: System owner

props.name: supports
props.remarks: An assessor independent of both the build and operate teams is one way to involve experts who did not serve as front-line developers in regular assessments. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The review evaluates how effective the monitoring metrics and processes are. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The review regularly reassesses whether metrics are appropriate and controls effective. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The assessor's review is one source of expert input on whether the system performs as intended. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The review examines measurement uncertainty and variability in monitoring results. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An assessor independent of the team that built or operates the system periodically reviews monitoring design, metrics, thresholds, and results, and findings are tracked to closure.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Schedule independent review by risk tier (for example, annually for high-risk systems); track findings in a risk register.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Independent review report; findings tracker.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: By risk tier; at least every two years.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Internal audit or external assessor

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Recording a local baseline with deviation thresholds is one response to the baseline-and-threshold gap. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A baseline is one reference point for functionality monitoring. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Choosing baseline metrics, and recording risks left unmeasured, is part of selecting measurement approaches. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A local silent trial measures performance under conditions like the deployment setting. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The baseline shows the system is valid and reliable locally and records limits on generalizability. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The baseline report documents the test sets, metrics, and tools used. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Numeric deviation thresholds state the organization's risk tolerance for this system. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A local baseline informs the determination of whether deployment should proceed. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The developer's same-source validity result is checked and recorded as part of the baseline. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The developer's external validity result is checked and recorded as part of the baseline. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The silent trial tests whether training data are relevant to the local deployed setting. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A baseline gives the local validity value a reference for interpretation. Pre-review audit: revised.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Before go-live, the organization records the baseline the system will be monitored against (validity metrics with uncertainty from the developer's internal and external validation results and, where feasible, from a local silent trial) and sets deviation thresholds that trigger review, correction, or deactivation.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Run a local silent (shadow) trial where feasible; record baseline metrics and confidence intervals; set thresholds in the monitoring plan.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Baseline report; threshold table in the monitoring plan.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Before go-live; after every model update.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Clinical or business owner with the data science lead

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A populated local-validity value is a measurement of validity in local data, which is this control's core. Pre-review audit: supported.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Where the deploying organization runs it, local validity monitoring is the process the attribute can describe. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Measuring local validity over time is one way to detect performance degradation. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Local validity monitoring is one form of functionality monitoring. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Measuring validity in production is one way to monitor the system's functionality. Pre-review audit: unresolved.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Local validity results are one factor for tracking emergent risk in the deployed context. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Local validity results document how well the system generalizes beyond the conditions under which it was developed. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Local validity results are measurement results on whether the system performs consistently as intended in its deployment context. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Catching degradation early sustains the value of the deployed system. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The intervention's validity in local data (for example discrimination, calibration, and positive predictive value at the operating threshold) is measured with confidence intervals at the planned cadence and compared with the baseline and thresholds.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Compute validity metrics on each monitoring window; flag threshold breaches to the owner.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Monitoring dashboard extracts; threshold breach log.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: As set in the plan (for example monthly or quarterly), plus event-driven.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Data science lead

controls.title: Input data and population drift detection

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Input drift detection is one way to detect drift before outcome labels arrive. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Drift monitoring gives local evidence on whether the training-data relevance statement holds. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The training data's demographic profile is the reference for population-mix monitoring. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Inclusion and exclusion criteria define which local patients fall outside the training population. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Monitoring the behavior of system components in production includes its input data. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Drift alerts show when the system operates beyond the conditions it was developed under. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Drift alerts identify emergent risks before outcome labels arrive. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Upstream change logging catches shifts elsewhere in the stack that silently alter inputs. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The distribution of input features, missingness, upstream data changes (for example code-set or EHR build changes), and the patient-population mix are monitored against the training-data description and the baseline, with alerts on meaningful shift.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Run drift statistics on each monitoring window; review alerts with data owners; record upstream changes.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Drift report; upstream change log; alert review notes.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Weekly or monthly automated; on upstream change.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Data engineering with the data science lead

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A label specification with adjudication is one response to missing ground truth. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Proxy measures with stated uncertainty are a risk-tracking approach for when metrics are not yet available. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Defining and adjudicating labels is construct validation for the monitored outcome. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The label specification records which risks are not yet measurable and why. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Local outcome labels come first for outcome-based validity measures such as discrimination and calibration; whether every local validity value is label-based is unresolved. Pre-review audit: unresolved.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: For label-dependent fairness measures such as subgroup calibration or error-rate parity, local outcome labels come first; label-free measures such as output-rate parity can be computed without them. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Adjudication statistics quantify uncertainty in the monitoring results themselves. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organization defines how and when reference-standard outcomes are obtained for monitored cases (source, label definition, expected delay, adjudication sample) and uses label-efficient or proxy measures, with stated uncertainty, while labels are delayed.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Write a label specification; adjudicate a sample of labels; report proxy measures with their limits until labels mature.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Label specification; adjudication agreement statistics; proxy-measure notes.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Defined before go-live; adjudication sample each monitoring cycle.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Clinical owner with the data science lead

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Same-data comparison of model versions is one form of systematic model comparison. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A retained time series is one way to lower the overhead of longitudinal tracking. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Version comparison makes measurable improvement part of every update. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Identifying a measurable improvement or decline requires performance from more than one point in time to be available for comparison. Pre-review audit: supported.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The time series shows risks that emerge slowly over many windows. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The comparison record shows the update process and frequency described in the attribute in practice. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The record shows how often performance was corrected after risks were found. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Monitoring results are kept as a time series across model versions and configuration changes, and every update is compared against the current version on the same local data before it goes live where the organization controls update timing, and otherwise promptly after.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Keep results in a versioned store; run a champion-challenger or before-and-after comparison for each update.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Longitudinal results store; version comparison reports.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Continuous retention; each update.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Data science lead

props.name: supports
props.remarks: MANAGE 2.4 names mechanisms, with assigned responsibility, to supersede, disengage, or deactivate a system; that mechanism is this control's core. Pre-review audit: supported.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A trigger-action table is a documented response plan for performance risks the organization rates high priority. Pre-review audit: unresolved.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Tiered actions prioritize treatment by the size of the breach. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Deactivation procedures cover safe phase-out of an AI system. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Defined response times make the system fail safely when it underperforms. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Deployer triggers show how often performance is corrected locally, which the attribute can describe. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: AI 800-4 reports practitioners' call for deviation thresholds 'to trigger corrective actions or reviews' (p. 18); this control ties threshold breaches to set actions. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Threshold breaches lead to pre-defined actions (review, recalibration or retraining request, restricted use, or deactivation) with a named authority, time limits, and user notification; reactivation requires a new baseline.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Write a trigger-action table; record each breach, the action taken, and its timing.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Trigger-action table; breach and action log; deactivation and reactivation records.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: On each breach.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: System owner with clinical leadership

props.name: supports
props.remarks: A local subgroup baseline is one documented fairness evaluation. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Subgroup analysis tests representativeness of the data for the local population. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Choosing subgroup metrics, and recording subgroups too small to measure, is part of selecting approaches. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Disparity thresholds are performance thresholds applied to subgroups. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The developer's same-source fairness result is checked and recorded as part of the baseline. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The developer's external fairness result is checked and recorded as part of the baseline. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: The demographic variables used as input features indicate which subgroups to monitor. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.remarks: Training-data representativeness shows which local subgroups the model saw little of. Pre-review audit: not audited.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: External-data representativeness shows which subgroups have external evidence. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Before go-live, validity by subgroup is recorded for the characteristics listed in 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11)(iv)(A)(5)-(13) (a list the regulation gives for evidence-based interventions, used here as a reference set) that are used as inputs or available locally, from developer and local silent-trial results, and subgroup disparity thresholds are set.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Monitoring activity
parts.prose: Compute subgroup metrics in the silent trial; compare them with developer-reported fairness; set disparity thresholds in the plan.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Subgroup baseline report; disparity threshold table.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Cadence
parts.prose: Before go-live; after every model update.

parts.name: guidance
parts.title: Owner role
parts.prose: Data science lead with the health equity lead

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Measuring subgroup performance in production is one ongoing fairness evaluation. Pre-review audit: unresolved.

props.name: supports
props.remarks: Subgroup performance is part of monitoring system behavior in production. Pre-review audit: not audited.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Subgroup validity and disparity in local data are measured at the planned cadence, and disparities beyond thresholds are investigated.

parts.title: Monitoring activity

parts.title: Evidence
parts.prose: Subgroup monitoring report; investigation notes.

props.name: supports

props.remarks: A central log store is one answer to fragmented logging across distributed infrastructure. Pre-review audit: revised.

props.name: supports
